title: Atlas Trading AI
author: Cobracones2
selftext: I am currently trialing the Atlas Trading AI algorithms. Anyone here has experience with the software for 6 months or more?  Deciding if I am going to subscribe or not.

replies.author: Cobracones2
replies.body: After trialing for 2 months, the account had lost \~4%.  I was trading on 3 different algos.  The "top 3" they recommended.  Their answer was for me to choose different algos to follow and they kept pointing out that several of their algos were up during the same period.  The issue is that you would have to correctly guess which algos to follow each month.  Needless to say, i ended the trial.
